_instructions: Wall quads are the four image corners of a wall face between two VERTICAL room corners, floor line to ceiling line (TL, TR, BR, BL). Mark only corners you can actually see.
Put two adjacent walls in the SAME frame (a vertical room corner view) so focal length can be recovered with a level camera.
height_anchor is the ceiling height the person states (user-supplied) or a floor-to-ceiling plane calibration; it is NOT measured by the camera.
